library_workarea_partition.meaning: SEMANTIC ANNOTATION, NOT CENSUS EVIDENCE: the machine-derived address-materialization census into the gp-tail data zone. Every reported site is a fact of the bytes (conservative linear tracker); a missed site proves nothing. Moves ZERO census bytes -- the walls below say exactly why, and each names its reopening falsifier class.
library_workarea_partition.owner_lists_meaning: verbatim observed owner sets either side of the $gp constant; names come from the symbol table (naming provenance, not proof of SDK identity). The below-gp set is dominated by PsyQ API names (libcd/libpad/libspu/libsnd/libgpu/libapi) with some game-side glue; it is reported verbatim precisely so no categorical 'all library' claim is encoded
walls: pointer_indirection: libcd parks work-area pointers in variables (e.g. 0x80081B8C/0x80081B94/0x80081B98) and accesses fields through loads of those pointers; static constant tracking ends at the load
caller_dependent_index_domain: the libpad port array 0x80081D48 (stride 4) is indexed by a caller-supplied port; bounding it needs the caller-domain proof class that blocked the local-base campaign

no_materialized_clear_bounds: CD_init/_padInitSioMode initialize cells individually or through helpers (e.g. jal 0x8005F7DC with the area address as an argument); no memset-style loop materializes (base, end) as constants, so no atan-grade extent proof exists

atan_table.extent_claim_basis: instruction derivation ONLY; the analytic content model is approximate (+1 on a fixed entry subset, generator unknown, no uniform multiplier fits by interval intersection) and is reported as corroboration, never as the claim
atan_table.index_domain: 0..1024 = (min<<10)/maj with min <= maj by octant selection
